name: EnvMap-GS
aliases: two-stage outdoor Gaussian reconstruction with background-to-environment map baking
definition: A two-stage Gaussian Splatting framework that explicitly separates and optimizes foreground and background regions in outdoor 'inside-out' captures to reduce floaters and enable environment map baking.
summary: EnvMap-GS is a two-stage Gaussian Splatting framework that eliminates far-field floaters by separating foreground and background regions, constraining the latter to a spherical shell for efficient environment map baking.
